lines: Commits on track/p-admin-sidebar (base f948f970):
- f46d5750 fix(admin-ui): label the phone All sections lists by their headings (CL-10)
- 93a31164 feat(admin-ui): dock the desktop sidebar, let it hide, singles first
What changed (admin, lg and up only):

- Sidebar is docked: sticky at top var(--be-chrome-offset), height 100dvh minus that offset, no margin, corners or outer/inset shadow, border-r nav-hairline. Only the page list (nav) scrolls; the wordmark and toggle stay at the top.

- Toggle button beside the wordmark: visible 'Hide menu' with a left chevron; collapsed strip is 56 px (w-14) with a 44x44 button, sr-only 'Show menu' + title, chevron turned right. aria-expanded, aria-controls -> nav id; the nav gets the hidden attribute (display none, out of tab order and a11y tree). Same button element in both states, so focus stays (checked).

- Stored choice: localStorage key boe.admin.sidebar, values 'shown' / 'hidden'. Missing, unreadable or throwing storage means shown; a failed write is ignored (in-memory state still applies). Read synchronously in useState on mount: on reload only the stored width is ever painted (rAF width log: [56] hidden, [240] shown).
- Motion: width 200 ms ease-out under motion-safe only; nothing on first paint.

- Desktop order: Overview, Applications, Funds, AUM, then USERS, CLIENT VALUES, SUPPORT, MONEY, SYSTEM. orderSidebarGroups (shells/admin/adminSidebarOrder.ts) ranks groups by ADMIN_SIDEBAR_DOMAIN_ORDER and keeps any unlisted domain at the end, so no page can drop out; missing pages just disappear for any permission set.
- nav.order untouched: phone bottom bar still Overview, Users, Funds, Client values; All sections sheet keeps navGroups order (not reordered).
- CL-10: sheet group labels get id `${sidebarId}-more-${domain}` and their ul aria-labelledby when the group has more than one entry. Markup only.

Files: shells/admin/AdminFrame.tsx, new AdminSidebar.tsx, adminSidebarOrder.ts(+test), adminSidebarPreference.ts; ui/recipes/shellAdmin.ts. adminRoutes.ts, routeManifest.ts, layout.ts, tokens untouched.
Compatibility (rule 11): frontend only. No API, contract, response or server-data change; the only new persisted thing is a per-browser localStorage key. Released apps unaffected.
Tests (rule 10): adminSidebarOrder.test.ts, 3 tests (full order + no page lost, partial permission set, unlisted domain kept last). Expected labels are the maintainer's list. No styling tests.
Red control 3a3b2b13-c16e-4bcd-acfd-d944cdc400c5: orderSidebarGroups reverted to the pre-change identity order -> 3 of 3 failed; file restored, cmp identical, tree clean.

- 412 px: before-412 vs after-412, before-412-more vs after-412-more (sheet open), before-412-users vs after-412-users, and after-412-stored-hidden (key set to hidden): all byte-identical to the v0.18.3 build with animations disabled; two baseline shots were also identical, so the comparison is meaningful.
Browser steps for the maintainer (admin web, window 1024 px wide or more):
1. Sign in. The dark menu runs the full height on the left, flush to the edge, no rounded card; Overview, Applications, Funds, AUM sit above USERS.
2. Scroll a long page: the menu stays put; on a short window its list scrolls on its own while BeOnEdge and Hide menu stay at the top.
3. Click Hide menu: the menu shrinks to a slim strip with one arrow button, the page widens. Reload: still hidden, no flash of the wide menu.
4. Click the arrow (tooltip Show menu): the menu returns. Reload: still shown.
5. Keyboard: Tab to Hide menu, press Enter: focus stays on the button (ring visible), Tab skips the hidden links. Enter again restores.
6. Phone or APK: nothing changes; More sheet looks the same.
Emulator: nothing to test on the Rahul Kumar client account; this lane changes only the admin desktop layout.
Doubts / left:

- Toggle uses one inline chevron SVG in the style of the primitives' own glyphs. No icon set added; the Button primitive has no className and no tone for the dark nav, so a shell recipe (ADMIN_SIDEBAR_TOGGLE) styled like the sidebar links was used.
- The right-edge hairline is the nav hairline (parchment 14%), subtle against the dark panel; the panel's own contrast does most of the work.

- docs/ui-overhaul/plan.md FD-3 ('parked money group last') and UQ-5 ('web sidebar unchanged') predate this approval; the coordinator may want to note the 2026-11-18 order there. plans/admin-improvements.md lane list (near the p-admin-nav row) has no p-admin-sidebar row yet: not in my allowed files.
- Transition polish was kept (it was done before the 20:00 deadline note); remove the motion-safe width class if the maintainer prefers none.
